intervals.note: The directly fetched status paper confirms in its own words that NEXT-White "has recently finished operation at the LSC" as of January 2022, supporting `status: completed`. The 2016 start / 2021 end years themselves are carried from secondary summaries of NEXT-White run papers (Run I-V, depleted-then-enriched xenon) that this agent did not verify against a directly fetched primary source in this session; recorded as `confidence: uncertain` rather than left as a null/null interval (which would derive to 'no presence').
intervals.quote: The NEXT-White detector has recently finished operation at the LSC.

name: NEXT-White
notes: Placed at site:lsc-canfranc (now created by the facilities lead; no longer a dangling reference).
Start/end years are from secondary summaries, not a directly fetched primary source; see interval note. `status: completed` itself is directly sourced.

placements.quote: approved to start data taking at the Laboratorio Subterráneo de Canfranc (LSC), Spain, in 2014

isotope.quote: filled with 100 kg of Xe enriched in Xe-136

summary.plain: A smaller demonstration version of the NEXT detector, using high-pressure xenon gas, that ran at the Canfranc underground laboratory before the full-size NEXT-100 detector was built.
summary.technical: NEXT-White (NEW): smaller-scale (~5 kg xenon, per secondary literature not independently re-verified in this session) prototype phase of the NEXT high-pressure xenon gas TPC programme at LSC, preceding NEXT-100.

technology.quote: a radiopure high-pressure xenon gas TPC
technology.value: High-pressure xenon gas time projection chamber with electroluminescence readout
